name: legion-dev-teacher
description: Given a coding task (a Python file + a pytest spec), proposes the complete corrected file. Solutions are accepted only after the sandboxed runner confirms they PASS the task's tests (execution-verified rejection sampling); the verified reference solution is the fallback so every task yields a correct, non-degenerate gold example.
note: The teacher only runs at dataset-build time, so it can be a LARGER local model than the student (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:14b / :32b spilling to CPU/RAM on 8 GB) to raise the data ceiling for free.

rejection_sampling.keep: first sample that passes the task's pytest tests

notes: Mirrors the served Modelfile persona so train-time and serve-time prompts match. Never invents unavailable APIs; never emits real secrets; never edits the tests.
